dialog: Do note that I bear no grudge against you in particular.
May I have this battle?
Perhaps you'll step out of my way?
Allow me to measure your strength.
It's your unlucky day.
This is the consequence of your poor grasp of how to finish the job.
I'm surprised you're still right there.
If you intend to keep obstructing me/ I won't show you a shred of mercy.
I'll bring you down right here.
This was quite ill-advised of you.
You're an opponent I can't leave be.
If you're going to keep standing in my way/ then...
Your guard is absurdly open/ you know?
Allow me to demonstrate the strength of a maid of Lady Shinki's household.
Let's finish this/ swiftly and efficiently.
Even if we have to die on each other's blades!
I will not give in!
My blade is not yet broken!
If I have no way out of this/ the proper move is...
I see where you're going...
There!
How careless...
You'll get hit like that!
You won't...
You won't... escape my aim!
Executing my attack...
Hah!
Your positioning isn't half bad...
Your positioning isn't half bad... for this!
There's still far more blades to be had...
Have some more!
I can't treat you to the full course...
I can't treat you to the full course... but I hope you'll find this to your liking!
A maid's uniform...
A maid's uniform... is filled with secrets!
By all means...
By all means... please/ take the whole thing.
At this range...
At this range... You're mine!
I'll bring you to checkmate...
I'll bring you to checkmate... right there!
There's no way you can follow this.
Have some more!
You're too slow!
I'll run you through!
I'll finish you right here.
I have you now!
And another strike!
Executing a continuous attack!
You should fear it!
And another strike!
I'll settle this here.
Your guard was open!
And it still is!
The firm solidity of my blade...
You should fear it!
And another strike!
I will now carry out my role.
I'll carve you to pieces!
I'll carve you to pieces!
Your guard is crumbling―in that case...
Your guard is crumbling―in that case...
I'll finish you off!
I will not allow you near Lady Shinki!
Allow me to show you my preferred style of battle.
Allow me to show you my preferred style of battle.
No matter how many blades I must break...
No matter how many blades I must break...
...You're mine!
...You're mine!
And in the end/ victory goes to me.
I have more than enough blades for this.
I'll cut my way through...
I'll cut my way through...
I'm not done yet!
And now...
It's over!
Get out of our sight.
I'll show you my sword dance.
Entree...
Entree... Grand Adage...
Entree... Grand Adage... Coda!
And now...
Time for the curtain call.
I worked up quite a sweat.
To press the attack now would put myself in more peril than the enemy.
One must occasionally cede ground to the enemy/ after all...
That was clumsiness on my part.
I see that you know how to fight.
What―what have I done?!
Allow me to make the deciding blow.
You seem to be running behind schedule.
I will handle this.
We'll focus our attacks.
I'll press them further.
I still have more swords left.
You throw them off balance/ and I will pierce them.
This isn't over yet.
Withdraw immediately!
It's fine. I exist for this very purpose.
I must keep damage to my allies to a minimum.
I will be our shield!
I will take this blow.
I'll go out ahead.
If we put our attacks on the same trajectory/ we should hit.
I will follow your instructions.
I will support you/ of course.
Please don't let yourself dawdle.
We'll focus our attacks.
I entrust you with directing my sword.
I'll put all my spirit into my swords!
I'll show you moves befitting Lady Shinki's blade!
Alice/ don't do something so stupid!
You need to finish the job/ Alice.
Attack them properly/ Alice.
Alice/ you're not watching your surroundings.
Alice/ dodge the next one!
Out of the way/ Alice!
Alice/ I'll go out ahead.
Show me your way of fighting/ Alice.
I'm leaving the final blow to you/ Alice.
I'll provide assistance/ Alice.
Alice/ follow after me.
Alice/ I entrust you with directing my sword.
Let's show them moves befitting Lady Shinki's blade!
Alice... you're showing a lot of spirit.
Lady Shinki?! Right in front of my eyes...
Lady Shinki/ I will settle this matter.
Lady Shinki/ please allow me to handle this.
Lady Shinki/ I live to serve.
I am here to protect you/ Lady Shinki.
It will be as you ask/ Lady Shinki.
Lady Shinki/ I'll go out ahead.
Lady Shinki/ I will assist in your efforts.
Lady Shinki/ please do not over-exert yourself.
The preparatios are complete/ Lady Shinki.
I will accomplish my most cherished dream...
Please/ Lady Shinki/ by all means...
I am Lady Shinki's blade.
I can't believe Lady Byakuren would/ for me...
Lady Byakuren/ please allow me to handle this.
Lady Byakuren/ I will settle this matter.
Lady Byakuren/ I will be your shield.
I would never ignore you in such a time of crisis/ Lady Byakuren.
Lady Byakuren/ I will assist in your efforts.
Lady Byakuren/ I'll go out ahead.
It will be as you ask/ Lady Byakuren.
With steel sword and adamant body!
Please/ Lady Byakuren/ by all means...
Lady Byakuren/ I entrust you with directing my sword.
Yuuka/ are you bothering to try?
This isn't like you at all/ Yuuka.
Withdraw. This too is one of my duties.
If you're going to fight/ then fight in earnest!
Show me how polished your skills can be.
I do think highly of your spirit/ if nothing else.
Vexing though it may be/ I entrust you with directing my sword.
Mima/ are you bothering to try?
This isn't like you at all/ Mima.
Withdraw. This too is one of my duties.
If you're going to fight/ then fight in earnest!
Show me how polished your skills can be.
I do think highly of your spirit/ if nothing else.
Vexing though it may be/ I entrust you with directing my sword.
I'll block out the pain...
I'll stop this attack right here!
I won't let you break my guard!
Even if I must push myself somewhat/ I'll manage to keep away!
I fully predicted your movements.
There's not a chance this could hit me.
Make a pointful attack next time.
I must congratulate you on at least managing to hit me.
An enemy who doesn't know their own place/ I see.
This poses no problem for further combat.
A decidedly effective attack.
I'm getting overwhelmed?!
They broke through my defenses?!
I'm at my―no/ I can still fight on.
They predicted my movements?!
... So you have some capability at this after all.
I will admit―it was a good attack.
I do not believe that was negligence on my part...
... You're good.
It seems I underestimated you...
Taking a little bit of fire is unavoidable.
Even if you've managed to hit me―!
By all means/ finish this/ if you can.
Just this?!
That won't stop me!
You're lacking in precision.
I'll let you in on how I did this: I can see right through you.
Evasive action... successful.
I read your attack the moment you took your stance.
Your aim is insufficient for this.
It's unacceptable to be too hasty.
I have no desire to take a direct hit.
In battle/ one must limit the damage one takes.
Ah/ so it's like this...
I cut my way through.
As if that attack could manage it!
Aim properly next time/ please.
This doesn't even amount to a fight.
You can't even touch me.
Intercepting the enemy's attack!
And you think you're fit to cross blades with me?!
That won't even reach me.
You were too slow in transitioning into your attack.
Don't complain that this is poor etiquette/ alright?
... Retreating.
... How humiliating.
I'm ashamed to say/ I'll be relying on you all to finish this.
Like this/ I'm not fit to be Lady Shinki's blade...
You don't give off any gravitas.
Don't worry/ I intend to use every part of the sheep.
You should know: In Makai/ there's always a bigger fish.
I know how to deal with a large opponent.
I've seen your movements before!
I won't hold my blade back/ even against a familiar face.
I do wonder if it's dangerous to get close to you...
Lady Byakuren's nightmare... I suppose this counts as a rematch.
I think I'll be a little harsher on you than usual.
If I'm facing Yuuka Kazami/ I need not hold back at all.
To challenge us so rashly is pure folly.
Don't worry/ I intend to use every part of the sheep.
You're not done using that power/ are you?
If you're going to change your patterns―
This has become a waste of my swords.
I too wish to ascertain your power.
I cannot allow myself to lose/ for Lady Shinki's sake.
I know well from experience the power of dreams...
A great/ onrushing torrent of dreams... but I'll show you how my blade can pierce through them!
I too wish to ascertain your power.
I cannot allow myself to lose/ for Lady Shinki's sake.
I know well from experience the power of dreams...
A great/ onrushing torrent of dreams... but I'll show you how my blade can pierce through them!
Finally/ it is time to drive you out.
I'll make sure you don't even think of coming near us for a while.
